name: Wiki — auto-ingest new raw sources (TEMPLATE, DORMANT)

meta.description: Watches the mounted vault (/vault/00-Raw) for new files and runs pipeline/ingest_one.sh on the HOST for each. SHIPS DISABLED: the trigger nodes have "disabled": true and ingest_one.sh is itself a no-op until INGEST_CMD is configured. Runs in the n8n Docker container; since the container has no git/model, the Execute Command SSHes back to the host. To activate: choose a model backend, wire INGEST_CMD on the host, set up the container->host SSH key, enable the trigger nodes, then activate the workflow. Replace SERVER_USER, SERVER_IP and VAULT_PATH below with your values.

nodes.name: Watch 00-Raw/Voice
nodes.notes: DISABLED until activation. Polls for new .md transcripts dropped by the voice pipeline.

nodes.name: Watch 00-Raw/Clippings
nodes.notes: DISABLED until activation. Polls for new web clippings from the Obsidian Web Clipper.

nodes.name: Run ingest_one.sh (on host)
nodes.notes: Maps the container path (/vault/...) back to the host path and SSHes to the host to run ingest_one.sh, which holds the shared ingest lock, runs $INGEST_CMD, and commits one source per run. Replace VAULT_PATH, SERVER_USER and SERVER_IP. Needs a container->host SSH key at /home/node/.ssh/wiki_ingest (set up at activation). No-op while INGEST_CMD is unset.
